verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe launch-time cloud-init configuration, an API, and webhook notifications for support tickets, but there is no evidence of a general rules/automation engine letting users define arbitrary event-triggered actions on their infrastructure (e.g., auto-scaling, auto-stop, budget alerts). Community evidence even shows a direct gap: a user asked for auto-stop/usage-limit triggers on idle instances and Lambda explicitly said it does not distinguish idle from in-use states and did not implement such rules.
